svg.title: Crab internal architecture with enterprise cache and auth services
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing Git and Crab client surfaces, core chunking, staging, metadata, cache, object storage, and optional enterprise auth and cache services.
svg.text: Reads: local cache -> cache service -> origin. Pushes: origin first, best-effort cache warm.
Serverless Git remote helper: local chunking and metadata, object-storage authority, optional enterprise cache and auth services.
